card.name: Words that lead into a specifying detail
card.fires_on: A word right after a noun or verb that opens a qualifier, such as "depending" (on), "specifically", "something" (like), or "operations". It is seen in general technical or academic web text, where the next words give the specifics.

modes.description: A word after a technical noun that leads into a narrower specification.
modes.example: Inverse[m, Modulus->n] evaluates the inverse<< modulo>> n.
